No guaranteed scholarship/credit exemption, extra course, extension, living or travel costs are deducted or bundled. Exact 2027/28 whole fee HKD 199,400; approximately HKD 8,309 per credit is rounded, so do not replace the total by 8,309 x 24. Prior 2026/27 tuition HKD 189,800 and subsidised HKD 89,800 are NOT this intake. FTSS 2027/28 is explicitly unconfirmed/subject to UGC approval; do not subtract HKD 100,000. Caution money HKD 350 is separate.
options.deadlineNote: September 2027 central TPG schedule: opens5 October 2026; early4 January 2027, main15 February 2027, final10 May 2027 non-local/31 May 2027 local. Faculty first-round4January wording is not a final cutoff; programme exceptions override the central sequence. Capacity may close earlier, no guaranteed live opening, invented later-round opening, midnight cutoff or automatic late extension.

boundaries.languages: EN/ZH snapshots separate; digital programmes IELTS6/components5.5, TESOL7/components6.5, MATCIL Chinese AND applicable English, MACSLE explicitly optionalEnglish, music major OR minor.
boundaries.dates: MADLIC unqualified4January2027 cutoff takes precedence over central May finals; explicitly first-round dates for other programmes are not their finalcutoff. No event, visa processing, scholarship, interview or midnight deadline invented.
boundaries.fees: 2027/28 figures distinguished from old MAGHE140800/2024/25 and VisualArts189800/2026/27. Music180000/MATCIL217800 have unlabelled fee years and stay numerically unknown. VisualArts199400 exact total overrides rounded per-credit multiplication;2027FTSS unconfirmed.
boundaries.documents: VisualArts2027 HTML requires three document types, but linkedPDF is2026 Intake/updated25Sep2025. Detailed pages/projects/WORDS/CHARACTERS are historical guidance pending2027 confirmation, not enforced current limits.
boundaries.sources: One observed500 on Chinese feeURL succeeded on a recorded retry; misspelled VisualArts ruition path redirects to homepage, while actual menu tuition URL provides current price. Successful HTTP is not automatically usable field evidence. Eight central same-day sources reused with original dates/hashes.
boundaries.academic: No entry GPA, universal teacher qualification, teaching work-year, optional Australian progression or post-entry dissertation grade invented as base requirement. MAATLL approval discrepancy remains held research evidence.
boundaries.identity: MADLIC official /madlic alias was directly fetched and redirected to its canonical faculty URL. Retain the requested alias for immutable directory route identity and record BOTH requested/final evidence; no permissive URL matching or historical directory rewrite.
